title: Degeneracy: From Graphs to Matroids
summary: A graph is $k$-degenerate if every subgraph has a vertex of degree at most $k$. We extend this notion to matroids, defining a loopless matroid $M$ to be $k$-degenerate if every restriction of $M$ contains a cocircuit of size at most $k$; $M$ is minimally $k$-degenerate if it has cogirth $k$ and every proper restriction of $M$ has cogirth at most $k-1$. Our main result characterizes extremal minimally $k$-degenerate matroids. We also extend the known arboricity bound for matroids, showing that $k$-degenerate matroids have arboricity at most $k$ and providing sharper bounds.
